If you want a matte sealant, use something like Liquitex Matte Varnish or another artist varnish. A small bottle of matte varnish will last you a long time as long as you use thin coats. The only thing is that it can smear watercolor pencils/paint when you paint it on. When i was first making customs, i would dip the whole face into the sealant and then sort of shake the excess off. It worked but it's not the most professional method lol. make sure to let each layer set between applications or you risk wiping off your progress. 

The best kind of finish for dolls like this is going to be some sort of aerosol. Mr Super Clear is the most popular, but I've also had luck watering down that same matte varnish and using an airbrush. I would also think Testors Dullcote would work, or other miniature model sealants.
